title: Horseshoe representative and canonical boundary comparison
statement: For a scheme X and a compatible injective horseshoe of a short exact module-sheaf sequence S, let q be a global section of S.X3. For any global section b of IB^0 and cycle a of Gamma(IA)^1 satisfying beta^0(b)=aug_C(q) and alpha^1(iCycles(a))=d_B(b), the degree-one resolution isomorphism sends moduleCohomologyBoundary(toRightDerivedZero(q)) to homologyPi(a).

proof.text: Apply rightDerived_triangle_connecting to global sections and the fixed compatible horseshoe. Its first conjunct supplies the short exact global complex sequence and its transported snake boundary. Its second conjunct identifies the same delta map with the derived triangle boundary. Unfold moduleCohomologyBoundary, cancel the equality transport on the degree-zero source and the comparison isomorphisms on the degree-one target, obtaining boundary followed by the degree-one resolution comparison equals the degree-zero resolution comparison followed by the snake boundary.

The cycle z = IC.toRightDerivedZero' applied to q includes to the augmentation of q. The augmentation is a cocycle since its composite with the differential is zero. Apply the concrete snake formula ShortComplex.ShortExact.δ_apply with that augmentation, b, and iCycles(a), using hb and ha. Monicity of the cycles inclusions identifies its constructed cycles with z and a. InjectiveResolution.toRightDerivedZero_eq identifies toRightDerivedZero followed by the degree-zero resolution comparison with toRightDerivedZero' followed by homologyPi. Evaluate the boundary comparison on toRightDerivedZero(q) and compose these equalities to obtain the required identity.

proof_origin.note: Written from the existing fixed-horseshoe triangle comparison and Mathlib concrete snake and degree-zero comparison formulas; proved in Lean without new holes.

mathlib_searches.query: Injective first object in a short exact sequence makes it split; an additive functor preserves split exactness
Connecting homomorphism computed on a cocycle from a lift through a short exact sequence of cochain complexes
The connecting homomorphism in a short exact sequence of cochain complexes sends the class of a cocycle to the class of the differential of a lift

theorem boundary_horseshoe_boundary_identification (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))]
    [EnoughInjectives X.Modules]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [(RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).Additive]
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁)
    (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂) (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃)
    (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex)
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
    (hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.f ≫ IB.ι)
    (hιB : IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).map S.g ≫ IC.ι)
    (hrows : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval X.Modules (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (q : S.X₃.val.obj (op ⊤))
    (b : (IB.cocomplex.X 0).val.obj (op ⊤))
    (a : (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).cycles 1)
    (hb : (β.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) b = (IC.ι.f 0).val.app (op ⊤) q)
    (ha : (α.f 1).val.app (op ⊤)
      ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).iCycles 1 a) =
        (IB.cocomplex.d 0 1).val.app (op ⊤) b) :
    (IA.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) 1).hom
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomologyBoundary X.toRingedSpace S hS 0
        ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app S.X₃ q)) =
      (RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex IA).homologyπ 1 a
